title: Unknown crash is caused by custom module or in Godot
body:

Hi friends, I'm encountering an issue where I wrote a custom C++ module, and the game example occasionally crashes when running. Can you tell from this stack trace whether the problem is with my module or with Godot itself? By the way, is there any convenient way to debug such memory errors?

### Steps to reproduce

When I run project. It's occasionally occurs.

none
